title: Observation-Gated Rewards and Hero Commerce
purpose: Define how the local node city turns observed filesystem/building spaces into useful rooms, rewards, live actions, and commercial hero render opportunities.
coreThesis: The node is not a 3D file manager. It is a situational, observable city. Unobserved spaces stay cheap and abstract; observed floors materialize as rooms with utility, play, insight, narrative, or commerce.

renderPolicy.name: observe_to_materialize
rules: Only render expensive interiors when a human, Alison, camera, or agent explicitly observes a building/floor/room.
Keep distant city geometry symbolic: district, building, health lights, activity windows, and alert beacons.
Use 2D/HTML overlays for reading and operating; use 3D for situated meaning, emotion, discovery, and spatial memory.
Cache observed rooms by deterministic seed so revisiting feels continuous without scanning the whole machine again.

observationLoop.trigger: click, gaze, voice command, agent patrol, or notification tap
observationLoop.example: Alison enters the Q: district and observes Data/Memory.

observationLoop.trigger: Hub filesystem anatomy or cached manifest lookup
observationLoop.example: Read shallow metadata, size, modification time, tags, and known ALISA roles without deep blocking recursion.

observationLoop.trigger: local rules first, optional light LLM pass only when value is high
observationLoop.example: Memory folder becomes Archive Tower; tests folder becomes Probe Gym; vendor app becomes branded hero room.
Render a memory archive, game table, tool bench, market stall, or commercial hero showroom.
Useful tool, cleanup quest, memory crystal, mini-game, product portal, or live action.
JobBoard task, Akasha crystal, WorldChain event, filesystem change, or commerce telemetry.

rewardClasses.description: A real local capability exposed as a prop or workbench.
A lightweight training/game layer that maps play to safe computation or testing.
A found piece of canon, lesson, diary, or research surfaced at the place where it matters.
A visual diagnosis of disk, process, queue, vector store, hub, or service health.
A visible surface that can become rent, portal, product passport, or transaction point.
A premium representation of a real component, app, device, service, or brand inside the node city.
A task that can be posted to JobBoard or delegated to a Being, turning discovery into work.

heroRenderTargets.renderValue: Make invisible machine state emotionally legible: heat, load, pressure, bottlenecks, resource abundance.
Turn daemon health into characters, buildings, towers, and patrol routes.
Create branded hero rooms that explain, celebrate, and launch real tools.
Expose ALISA internal systems as navigable civic infrastructure.
Let each folder become a place with affordances instead of a passive path string.

businessModels.description: Rent visible in-world surfaces such as billboards, shop windows, screens, gallery walls, or wraps.
A surface opens an L3 service: VOD, NFT gallery, ecommerce, food delivery, music, ebooks, or partner app.
Virtual purchase can mint a deed/passport; real product purchase can spawn a matching digital prop.
Brands issue product passports and earn status inside the city under ALISA karma/verification rules.
Commercial programs, hardware, or partner services can sponsor canonical hero renderizations.
Play and care become bounded useful computation, with rewards tied to work and transparency.

existingEvidence.role: Existing renderer fetches /system/filesystem, maps filesystem nodes to buildings, stores buildingData, and supports raycast inspection.
Existing bounded filesystem anatomy endpoint with cache and exclusion rules.
Current local planet/city contract with drives, domains, and bounded ALISA nodes.
Canon for commercial surfaces, L3 rooms, NFT deeds, and revenue categories.
Research on FSN/fsv failures, QR city geometry, and ALISA's situational-dashboard advantage.
Canon for play as computation and local work as visible resource gathering.
Canon for SCUMM-like semantic interaction: objects, Beings, tools, drama, and WorldChain events.
Four-layer product architecture: engine, framework, portal, data/Souljar.
B2B strategy for DPPs, brand/status economy, and product-market bridge.

designGuardrails: Do not recreate the failed 3D file explorer pattern: search, grep, and 2D lists remain faster for file operations.
Never scan the full machine synchronously from a visual interaction.
Render symbols first, details on observation, and actions only with explicit consent or known safe automation policy.
Commercial rendering must be clearly separated from system truth and must not obscure health/security signals.
Every generated room should answer at least one of these questions: what is here, what changed, what can help me, what can I safely do, why does this matter.
